subject: MAP + contract sequencing: MSA / DPA / Order form timing (TrueNorth)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@truenorth.health>, TrueNorth Procurement <procurement@truenorth.health>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + proposed sequencing for TrueNorth POC

Hi Elena / TrueNorth procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today — great alignment on scope for the 6-week POC. To keep momentum, I’m sharing a first-pass mutual action plan (attached) that maps evaluation milestones to the contract steps we discussed (MSA review, DPA scoping, and the order form signature). Key assumptions are in the first tab.

Short summary:
- Week 0 (kickoff): exec sponsor alignment + kickoff 
- Weeks 1–2: environment prep, security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence exchange
- Weeks 2–4: model eval + integration (Rishi will own test harness)
- Week 5: final eval check, business validation
- Week 6: order form signature and handoff to customer success

Critical contract dependency: legal has asked that a baseline MSA be agreed (even with redlines) before final order form execution so procurement can commit the budget. We’ve noted a 5-business-day window for legal review/response in the MAP, but if TrueNorth prefers a longer redline cycle we can adjust dates.

Please review the attached MAP and the proposed dates in the second tab. Ask for: a one-hour procurement + legal kickoff (suggest Oct 1) to confirm timelines and who will own the DPA scope.

Attachments: TN-MAP-v1.0.xlsx, TN-Sec-Evidence-SOC2.pdf

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher

Subject: Re: MAP + proposed sequencing for TrueNorth POC

Thanks Sean — this is helpful and much appreciated. A couple quick notes from procurement/ops:

- Procurement prefers MSA agreed in principle before the PO is raised. Our legal team will likely request a 7–10 business day review for any redlines.
- For DPA: we need the specific data handling appendix populated (we’ll share our standard template). If Redwood can pre-populate the DPA fields that would speed review.
- SOC2 evidence looks good but our security team will run an IRT on the cert copies; we’ll let you know if anything else is required.

I can do the Oct 1 kickoff at 10:00 AM PT — I’ll invite legal and procurement.

-Elena
Director, Strategic Partnerships | TrueNorth Health
elena@truenorth.health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + proposed sequencing for TrueNorth POC

Hi Elena — looping in from Redwood legal.

High level: we’re happy to go through a standard 7–10 business day redline cycle. To avoid blocker risk we recommend the following sequencing in the MAP:

1) Exchange baseline MSA (we will send our standard MSA and would appreciate any TN markups in a single redline doc).
2) While MSA redlines are in-flight, populate the DPA appendix with the rough data categories and retention fields so security can start review in parallel.
3) Order form should be prepared with pricing and SKUs, but execution targeted after MSA is in agreed form (can be signature-ready earlier if both parties accept written approval to execute after MSA).

If procurement wants to shorten the MSA window we can accelerate internal review but would need a confirmed point-by-point redline log from TN.

I’ll join the Oct 1 kickoff and bring a redline template.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@truenorth.health>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + proposed sequencing for TrueNorth POC

Hi all — technical note to accompany the MAP: 

- Test harness: I’ve attached a short evaluation checklist (in the MAP tab) that outlines exact traffic profiles, latency SLOs (p95 targets), and the synthetic dataset we’ll use. This ensures the final acceptance criteria are unambiguous.
- Infrastructure: for the POC we will provision a dedicated sandbox with token-level logs and a 30-day KV cache for performance consistency.
- Security handoff: we’ll provide a read-only Cloud Storage bucket with redacted logs for your security team; if TN needs on-prem evidence, let me know and we’ll schedule a live review.

Planning note: the technical acceptance milestone (Week 5) is gated — legal needs to have MSA scoped and procurement OK to move to order form. If MSA slippage >7 business days we should shift the order form execution by the same delta.

Regards,
Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena@truenorth.health>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: TrueNorth Procurement <procurement@truenorth.health>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + proposed sequencing for TrueNorth POC

Thanks everyone — kickoff notes below. Key outcomes:

- Procurement will route the baseline MSA to legal by Oct 4. TN legal requests a 10-business-day review window (we are confirming resources to shorten if possible).
- Procurement will fill the DPA template and send to Laura by Oct 6 — Laura asked TN to pre-populate data categories / retention where possible.
- Security: TN security conducted a cursory SOC2 check and flagged one question around egress logging; Rishi to provide sample logs by Oct 8.
- Tentative adjusted timeline: if TN legal uses full 10 business days, target order form signature moves from Week 6 to Week 8 in MAP.

Next steps / owners:
- TN procurement (Jacob) to upload DPA template and proposed PO cadence (Jacob) — by Oct 4
- Redwood legal (Laura) to send baseline MSA — by Oct 4
- Rishi to share sample logs — by Oct 8
- Sean to update MAP with revised dates and circulate — by Oct 5

Appreciate the clarity — will reconvene after the initial exchange.

Best,
Elena

- Nov 9: Redwood sends counter-MSA with highlighted core economics and liability language; Laura will be available for a synchronous 60–minute review.
- Nov 12: Target for TN to provide consolidated redline doc or acceptance.
- Nov 15–16: If MSA agreed, proceed to DocuSign order form signing the week of Nov 16.

Please confirm if Nov 9 synchronous review works and whether procurement needs any additional paperwork to issue a PO once the MSA is agreed.
